name: Castle gate and wall stair
description: #97 Functional castle gate: a wall tile with a passage, oak doors and an optional portcullis, the same height as the wall so the walk continues over it. Plus a stone stair that climbs to the wall walk (the walls are reached only from a tower, a gate or a stair). Pieces of the wall kit; concepts for review.

variants.name: Gate, closed
variants.notes: Passage along grid x, oak doors shut.

variants.name: Gate, open
variants.notes: Doors swung back against the jambs: units walk through.

variants.name: Gate with portcullis
variants.notes: Open doors behind a half-raised iron portcullis.

variants.name: Gate, open (other direction)
variants.notes: Passage along grid y, for a wall running along x.

variants.name: Stair to the wall walk
variants.notes: Steps up along grid x to the walk; placed beside a wall or gate tile.
